description: This file defines the AuthenticationChain class responsible for handling user authentication via multiple providers within the Eclipse Ditto gateway security module. It coordinates authentication requests, aggregates results, and provides an API for authenticating request contexts.

classes.name: AuthenticationChain
classes.description: Handles authentication by multiple providers, manages the authentication flow, and aggregates results for request validation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AuthenticationChain instance with specified providers, failure aggregator, and dispatcher.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication of a request context and returns a future with the authentication result.
